context: Two athletes prep for an Olympics qualifying training camp
purpose: Teach: オリンピック/キャンプ/プレイヤー/ブロック/シュート/ゲスト/大勢/進ま

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 明日からの合宿キャンプ、ついにオリンピック代表を決める大事な時期だな。
lines.en: Starting tomorrow's training camp, it's finally the crucial period that decides the Olympic representatives.
lines.style: Calm, focused tone with a slight sense of pressure

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: はい、緊張します。今年は海外から有名なプレイヤーもゲスト選手として来るんですよね？
lines.en: Yes, I'm nervous. This year famous players from overseas are coming as guest athletes too, right?
lines.style: Respectful and slightly nervous younger athlete voice asking

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そうだ。だからこそ守備、特にブロックの精度を上げないと話にならない。
lines.en: That's right. Precisely because of that, our defense, especially blocking accuracy, has to improve or we won't stand a chance.
lines.style: Authoritative and instructive senior speaking firmly to junior

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 正直、最近フリーシュート練習が思うように進まなくて悩んでます。
lines.en: Honestly, lately my free shooting practice hasn't been progressing the way I want, and it's been weighing on me.
lines.style: Confiding, slightly frustrated and vulnerable to mentor

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 焦るな。体の軸がぶれてるだけだ。明日コーチに見てもらえば一日で直る。
lines.en: Don't panic. Your body's axis is just off balance. If you have the coach check you tomorrow, it'll be fixed in a day.
lines.style: Reassuring mentor tone, confident and warm throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。会場には大勢の関係者も来るって聞いて、急に怖くなって。
lines.en: Thank you. I heard a large crowd of officials will be at the venue, and suddenly I got scared.
lines.style: Soft, openly admitting fear to a trusted senior

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 観客が多いほど力が出るタイプだろ、お前は。胸張っていけ。
lines.en: You're the type who performs better when there are more spectators, aren't you. Walk in with your chest out.
lines.style: Encouraging and teasing but supportive elder brother vibe

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: はい！レンさんと組めるの最後かもしれないし、絶対に悔いなく戦います。
lines.en: Yes! This might be the last time I can pair up with you, Ren-san, so I'll fight without any regrets.
lines.style: Determined, emotional, fired-up young athlete declaration

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: よし、その意気だ。今夜は早く寝て、明日のキャンプ初日を最高のスタートにしよう。
lines.en: Good, that's the spirit. Tonight let's sleep early and make tomorrow's first day of camp the best possible start.
lines.style: Wrapping up warmly, leader voice setting tone for tomorrow
